decisions: When it fails, the app has to say why and what to do next.
Add a show in Finder button to the settings screen.
Write a help page explaining how to turn the microphone permission back on.
action_items: Moira fixes the failure message by next Wednesday.
Rishi builds the show in Finder button this week.
Publish the microphone help page tomorrow.
not_items: About half of them ask where the notes are saved.
And a few people say that recordings longer than two hours never get a note.
